items.title: Which VOS commit does EXP-1 score?
items.lead: The VOS report read one commit of the vos-core branch, and every gap row cites paths there. EXP-1 scores that commit unless this item says otherwise.
bullets: vos-core and master are different products, per the report's section 1
Scoring a later tip means re-reading every gap row first
Reversible: a later run can score another commit under its own run id
items.rec: the report's commit, because every gap row cites paths there.
options: vos-core at its tip when T-007-03 starts

items.title: Where does the purpose-built store sit?
items.lead: The purpose-built store is a module of CMP-STM's crate, rutent-stm, beside the reference host, behind that crate's Cargo feature purpose-built-store, off by default. EXP-1 keeps it there unless this item says otherwise.
bullets: The boundary check lets rutent-stm depend on the contracts; a new crate of ours may depend on nothing of ours
A crate of its own would mean an eighth package against DEC-2's seven, and widening the boundary check
With the flag off, CI's workspace build, lints, docs and tests don't compile it; a run turns it on
Reversible: moving it later changes its path, not its code
items.rec: inside rutent-stm behind the feature, because the boundary check allows it there without a change.
options: A module of rutent-stm behind the purpose-built-store feature (recommended)
A crate of its own, with DEC-2 and the boundary check widened to allow it
